messages.text: Sauce is already on. Your grandmother asked if you are coming before noon or just for plates later.
I can make dinner. Going to skip the 9:30 part this week and help Dad with the chairs when I get there.
That is fine. Wear something decent and say hello to Grandpa first, please.
I will. Tell Nonna I am bringing the bread from Giacomo's.
If Tyler's uncle still wants you two in that attic Saturday, start before lunch and don't haul boxes twisted up.
That buzzing near the panel at your grandparents' place is probably the loose breaker I mentioned. Do not poke around until I look at it.
Yeah, I remember what happened doing that in July. I'm packing the small fan and taking the ladder in slower trips.
Got it. I am only going by after work to carry the groceries in and check the porch light.
Good. Keep the orange bottle in the truck and eat first if you use it.
Bring your meter if you have it. Call me from the driveway before you touch anything.
Will do. Mia also asked if I can listen to her car after dinner Sunday.
Got it. Heating pad is already by the couch for when I get home.
Before you touch that subpanel, check the breaker chart again. Don't trust some fast clip without opening the book.
Yeah. I saved a 12-minute one from a guy who walks through the code section slow. I'll compare it with the manual before I do anything.
Good. Same with those rooftop battery clips. Half of them skip the ugly details.
I only watched that and two tool posts after work. Timer said 28 minutes, then I put the phone down.
Did you see the city is raising the permit fee for residential service upgrades again. Third hike in two years.
Yeah I saw the notice at the supply house. Council meeting on the 17th if they want pushback on it.
Look at you keeping a calendar on city hall.
Somebody has to. Half the guys at work just complain in the truck.
Dr. Patel's office moved that Thursday slot to 8:20 if you still want it.
Long one today. Dr. Halverson double-booked the morning so I was rebuilding the schedule until almost 2.
If the wrist is still sore Friday I'll call. For now I'm just icing it after work.
How does that even happen on the front desk system?
Two of us on intake, one on insurance, and the new girl still learning the referrals. I end up holding it together.
Bring the blue card from your benefits folder if you go. It kept the desk charge down last time.
Got it. Also going to ask him about that spring notice instead of reading random posts.
Sunday dinner still on? Dad off at his usual time?
You been okay this week honey? A lot going on in the news lately.
yeah I'm ok. been reading some of it, mostly just letting it sit.
Your dad's the same way. Nothing wrong with keeping it to yourself while you think.
yeah. plenty of people yelling about it already, don't need me adding to it
hey, my bedroom outlet keeps tripping when i plug the space heater + lamp into the same strip. is that the breaker being dramatic or something worse
probably the strip pulling more than that circuit can handle. heater alone is like 1500W, lamp on top of it = nope. what room is it sharing the breaker with?
i think the bathroom? everything cuts at once
yeah that tracks. put the heater on a different wall outlet, not the strip. i'll come by sat and pop the cover off, see if a backstab connection is loose. that panel is from like '88
Leaving in 10. I put the cooler by the door so we don't forget it after the site.
Got it. I'll grab the rods from the hall closet after I load my tool bag.
Works. No need to text during the day unless Wallace changes the panel list.
Good. I'll just tell you at the truck if anything moves.
foreman says we can wrap the panel today if we leave the neutral bar half done and finish tomorrow
nah I'd rather stay the extra 40 min and close it out clean. Don't want to come back to a half terminated bar in the morning
figured you'd say that lol. I'll grab the torque screwdriver, you want the 2026 book out for the bonding check?
yeah pull it. 250.92 is the one I want to read again before we button it up
Duke Energy hit my card. Your side is 74.60 whenever.
Sending it after dinner. Also got the March place payment set for Friday morning.
Good. If we go look at that Elm St one Sunday, I want to see where you'd put the saw so it doesn't take over everything.
That's why I liked the detached little building in the pictures.
You good? You shut the truck door pretty hard after the panel check.
Yeah. Long day. I kept thinking about whether I missed something on that upstairs run.
You checked it twice. Also rent is not due until Friday, so don't stare at the banking app all night.
I'm fine. Just worn out and probably not talking much tonight.
Did you finish that withholding form HR sent? Take the extra deduction if it pencils out. No reason to hand them more than you owe.
Yeah, redid it on lunch. They were taking too much. Same reason I'm not registering with either side, both of them keep digging in my wallet.
Smart. Keep the receipts for the boots and the meter, too. Tyler's brother went small business and said the write-offs add up.
Already got a folder going. If I ever pull permits under my own name I want that clean.
caro, saw on the tv that boy in Charlotte. mamma mia
I know nonna. the footage from the camera at least showed what happened
yes. you drive careful, you hear? always careful
always. brake light warning back in '23 is the worst I ever had. you and nonno raised us steady, no trouble
rough day yeah. you barely said two words at dinner
long shift. gonna call my mom in a bit
cool. also that guy still wants the cooler. you said $40?
yeah meet him saturday at the harris teeter
you stopping at the Tractor Supply on the way home? my left boot finally split at the toe today
saw mine yesterday, the sole is going too. gonna push it til after rent clears
ducttaped the toe on my pants again this morning, holding for now
lol same. ill grab a frozen pizza, dont buy nothing
you in for 6:30 tomorrow
yeah. tue/thu locked in
cool. fridge is empty btw
grabbing chicken and rice on the way home. enough for both. trying to keep breakfast going too
Your mother said you were doing that computer paperwork tonight. Bring it Sunday if the questions look strange.
I think it is mostly done. It only asked for my W-2, the apartment address, and whether any agency forms came in the mail.
Good. Keep the papers in one folder. Your grandfather still does that with every receipt.
I put the truck title copy and the insurance renewal in there too, just in case it asks.
Did your check clear before you head over Sunday?
Yeah, $1,397.84 landed. I moved $175 out with Duke and the phone before I touched groceries.
Good. Keep a little at home too, with that truck acting old.
$60 is staying in the drawer. I am not using that unless something breaks.
Still want to roll at 5:15 tomorrow?
Up for the lake at 5 tomorrow?
Yep. Stopping at Food Lion on the way home. Want me to grab anything?
Yeah. I already put the rods by the door. Earlier the better.
Couple beers for after. Tall boys
I'll grab ice and worms after dinner. Same spot near Hagan-Stone?
Got it. 4 should be plenty for both of us
Works. I need a few hours by the water before the apartment and phone start up.
Saturday the 14th, what time should I tell Nonna? She wants the gravy on early.
Whatever works for her. Tyler's coming too if that's ok.
Good. I'm bringing your cake. Don't try to talk me out of candles this year.
fine. no singing please.
Mia said you sounded tired this week. Call when you get a chance honey.
yeah will do tonight. also did Aunt Tina tag me in the easter photos already?
She did, a few weeks back. Scroll your feed, they're still up there.
ok will look later. talk tonight
You still hitting the Y after we unload the van?
Yeah, just the cable stack and floor stuff. Nothing bouncy after carrying conduit all morning.
Good. I can grab the heavier reel so you aren't twisted up all day.
Appreciate it. If I do the easy circuit today, Tuesday's slot should still be fine.
Power bill posted. I can cover my half tonight after we get back.
Works. I'll send rent from my account this morning and you can hit me back for your part.
Cool. Trash is yours this week. Fridge looks empty except our lunch stuff.
I'll handle it before we leave. Not buying much until Sunday dinner anyway.
If you're using the old miter box, clamp the short pieces before you cut. They jump.
Yeah, I figured that out on the first leg. Going slower now.
Sand before stain, not after. And don't run the saw late if Tyler has work early.
I'll do the loud part before dinner and save the tiny rail stuff for later.
Your mother said you were stopping after work. Bring two containers if you want sauce.
I can do that. I still have rice at home, so one container is enough for tomorrow.
Take two. And if those little green squash plants made it through the cold night, cover them again.
I put a bucket over them before I left. I'll grab the containers around 6.
If you go by Food Lion later can you grab the cheap pasta Grandma likes? I'll pay you back Sunday.
Yeah. I'm keeping this run small anyway. Gas and the truck bill both hit this week.
Still trying to stay under the number you wrote on the fridge?
Close to it. If the total stays around $1,450-$1,500 before I move any over, I'm good.
You still thinking Asheville Saturday, or are we keeping it close with the lake?
Lake sounds smarter. Truck ate more gas than I figured this week.
Works for me. I can bring the grill stuff if you want to leave that little Reykjavik stash alone.
Yeah, do that. I put another $10 in it after rent cleared.
How'd the panel swap on Cornwallis go today
Long. Foreman had me pulling MC cable since 7. Back is wrecked.
Lift with your legs. You sit down with the prep book tonight or you skipping
Hour at least. I told myself I'd hit the hour mark every weeknight or the timeline slips.
How'd that PV install on Battleground go today
Long. Roof was a mess but I got to do the combiner box wiring. Foreman let me handle most of the DC side
Every one of these I'm on counts toward the hours. And it's the kind of work that pays more once I'm carded
Good. Stay on those crews. Guys who can do panels and rooftop both are the ones who end up running their own trucks
Sunday dinner this weekend? Haven't seen you in two weeks.
You make it home for dinner tonight or is it another late one?
Probably yeah. Foreman has us going Sat morning to finish the Westover panel but should be done by 1.
Late. Inspector didn't show til almost 4 and we had to redo a panel after he flagged it. Just pulled in.
Saturday too? That's the third Saturday this month.
You were up at 5:30 again. Eat something. There's leftovers if you want me to drop a plate Sunday.
I'm good. Sunday works. Tyler will eat anything you bring.
Just the morning. Same shop, same crew, just behind on this build. 5pm works for dinner.
Can I borrow that Pink Floyd one with the prism cover for dinner at Jenna's Friday?
Yeah, just keep the sleeve flat. I had it on last night while I cleared the workbench.
You still getting the Zeppelin copy you showed me?
Holding off. Rent share plus the Duke Energy hit made March tighter than I wanted.
Marisol's kid is a junior now and the guidance office told her he should just pick any 4-year. Zero conversation about anything else.
Same thing they told me. Nobody mentioned GTCC or an apprenticeship. Took me two wasted semesters to figure it out on my own.
You should talk to her. Seriously. She listens to you more than she listens to me.
I'll grab coffee with him. Kid deserves to hear that a community college cert and a real wage is not a downgrade.
Aunt Lou called. Vince gets back from his last tour on the 21st. Family supper at her place Sat the 28th, 5 pm.
ok. need me to bring anything
Just yourself and something a little nicer than the work jeans. His guys from the unit are coming through too.
got it. ill be there
did mom text you about easter? she wants to know if you're picking up nonna and nonno or if dad is
haven't seen it yet. i can grab them, their place is like 12 min from mine
ok i'll tell her. she's doing the lasagna and the ham this year, nonna's bringing the pizzelles
classic. tell mom to text me the time and i'll plan around the saturday job
Did that website charge you extra for filing? Mine keeps trying to upsell me.
I stayed on the basic version. It said $138 coming back after I hit submit.
Nice. Did you have to hunt down a school interest form or anything weird?
No, just W-2, rent address, checking account, and a couple card statements from January.
Did you see the clip going around about the school library books? Everyone at work was screaming about it today.
Saw a headline. Honestly I scroll past that stuff. Whole month of yelling about library shelves and nobody at the statehouse said one word about Mrs. Vasquez waiting four months for a hip consult.
Right? And her rent went up again too.
That's the part that gets me. Fight about the loud stuff, ignore the boring stuff that actually wrecks people. I'd vote for whoever just fixed the boring stuff.
Pulled a double last night. Compressor on Line 3 finally died, had to wait for the part out of Charlotte.
Same one you patched twice last fall?
Same one. Plant manager's been told for two years. Anyway — keep your back straight on those overheads today. Don't muscle it.
Copy. Tell Mom I'll swing by after she's done at the office Thursday.
Don't rush those overhead runs tomorrow. Use the lift and keep your feet set.
I will. I kept tonight to slow reps and the mat. No deadlifts.
Smart. Two steady days a week beats one hard one that ruins the weekend.
That's the plan. Heat pad after dinner and early night.
That 12x16 outbuilding you sent has no window. You'd want air moving if you're sanding.
Yeah, I noticed. Still better than clamping boards on the balcony here.
Look at the panel first too. Don't buy into a headache.
I'm not buying anything soon. Tyler and I still have this place through summer.
You were pretty short on the phone last night. Did you get out before work?
Left while it was still dark. Walked the bank behind Lake Brandt for a bit.
Good. You usually sound more like yourself after that.
It helped. Tyler said we might do the longer water trip again next weekend if the weather holds.
I put the rice pack by the washer for you. Don't stay folded over those storage bins like last summer.
Thanks. I'm skipping the extra errand tonight and just doing the floor stretches after dinner.
That is the better choice. Also, no taking anything on an empty stomach.
I ate first. Same routine as last time, just earlier instead of waiting until I can't sit still.
You were very quiet at dinner. I saved you a plate, but you barely touched it.
You sounded worn out when you left the job site. Did you get something to eat?
Sorry. My head was still on work and the hours paperwork. I didn't mean to be rude.
Not yet. I am sitting in the truck a minute before I head home.
Come by for leftovers if you want. Your dad can look at the tool bag zipper while you eat.
You do that thing where you keep everything in and then answer too sharply. Call me before it stacks up.
I might. Can I call you first? I need to get my head straight before driving.
I know. Nothing big to make an appointment over. I just need to say it out loud sooner.
For Dad's birthday table, should I count you as one or are you bringing somebody from your place?
Count me as one. Tyler said he may stop by later but don't save a chair for him.
Got it. Mom asked because last time you two showed up together after work.
That was just easier with one truck. I'll come straight from the apartment this time.
You picking what we eat Saturday or letting Nonna run wild?
Letting her. She's doing it however she wants.
Heard. Mom said you and Tyler are hitting Joymongers after. Send me proof you ordered without flinching at the bartender 😂
Tyler's driving so probably.
Can you send me that reel with the tiny shelf brackets? Mine keep pulling loose.
Sent it. Same account had a clean way to predrill without splitting the board.
Of course your feed is brackets, wire nuts, fish pics, and old pickups.
Pretty much. I was only on there during dinner, about 25 minutes.
saw they're doing another walk downtown saturday for the elm st thing
jamie at work asked if you n me were going
saw the flyer. gonna pass. we still on for fishing 5:30?
yep same spot. told jamie i'd be on the water
I'm grabbing food after the site. You want anything or are you going straight to the garage?
Straight home. Need to get the stain coat on before the apartment smells like it all night.
All good. I'll keep the TV low when I get back.
Thanks. After that I'm just doing the little switch wiring upstairs.
The front desk said your visit balance is posted. It looks like $28 this time.
Thanks. I'll handle it Friday with the power bill. Just trying not to repeat that $1,650 month.
Do the small ones first so they don't sit there.
Yeah. If anything bigger pops up, I can pull from the set-aside and run tighter for a bit.
got pulled over on Battleground for 47 in a 35. $186 ticket. ughhh
rough. he write you up right there or just verbal?
ticket on the spot. did you ever get one from a stop? you never told me what happened that time
nah, one time ever, brake light, just a warning. nothing on paper. you want me to look at your truck once for anything that could get you stopped again
Can you send your half of Duke tonight or wait until next check?
Tonight is fine. I already marked the apartment stuff for Sunday so it will not get mixed up.
Cool. Rent still same on the 1st unless they surprise us.
Yeah. I am leaving the 3/20 deposit alone except for the regular $200 move and food.
You using the last two eggs tonight or can I grab one?
Take one. I'm doing noodles with the other and the bit of chicken from the blue container.
Cool. I moved your tray of dirt cups off the porch rail before the rain hit.
Thanks. Those are the basil ones, so I didn't want them soaked.
Grandma said her hallway outlet was sparking. I told her don't touch it till you come by
good. Tell her to pop the breaker for that circuit. I'll be over after work with a new receptacle and the tester
you don't have to do the whole tester thing for one outlet, just swap it
I want to check the box ground too. If it's a two wire run she's been on borrowed time. Won't take long.
How'd the open enrollment thing shake out? You stick with what you had?
Same plan. Nothing fancy but the deductible isn't terrible and the premium's manageable.
Dental?
Nope. Not offered. Two PTO days banked for the year so far, I'm saving them for when grandma needs the doctor run.
You still wanting to leave before sunrise or sleep in?
Rain looks done by 7. Still want to hit Higgins before the supply run?
Before sunrise. I packed the small tackle box already.
Yeah, just a short one. I'll make coffee and we can leave from here.
Cool. You skipping Hippo Records after?
Fine by me. I won't keep messaging about it; wake me if the truck won't start.
Yeah. I wrote down the Zeppelin shelf number, but bills first this week.
homeowner at the Hadley job is asking if we can also do the doorbell cam + the two Ring floodlights on the back of the garage while we're here
yeah easy. transformer in the hall closet is only 16V, we'll swap it for a 24V so the doorbell actually rings. floodlights tap off the existing porch box
she also asked about getting solar quoted later this year, told her that's not really us but i'd ask

we can do the array mounting and the DC run to the inverter no problem, just not the utility interconnect paperwork. tell her if she's serious i'll walk the roof next time i'm out, check rafter spacing and shading
Before you drive to Wilmington, price the tires. That front right looked thin.
I checked. Between tires and gas I'm probably pushing Wilmington off.
Good. Fix the truck first. Those northern airfare alerts can sit.
I know. I only kept the $20 auto move for the Reykjavik folder.
How's the back from that Sears panel job?
Fine. Stretching like you said. Didn't need to pop anything for it
Good. Next Sunday at the house. Mom's doing the gravy
Im in. Bringing a couple of the IPAs Nonna won't drink
Grazie for sabato, caro. You ate enough?
Always Nonna. The gravy was perfect.
Nonno would smile. From the day we brought you home from that hospital on Wendover till now, dio mio. Sunday come eat the leftovers.
Love you Nonna. I'll be there.
how was the week sweetie
decent. both gym days, breakfast every morning
good. you've sounded steadier since you got that schedule back in august
yeah. 30 min study blocks help too. i can't sit with the book for an hour anymore
Mom said your wrist was still bugging you. You actually going in or doing the Joseph thing?
It's better today. I don't want to pay another front-desk amount for something that's probably just from pulling wire.
Fair, just don't let it turn into a whole thing. Did Dr. Patel answer your question about that reminder card?
Yeah, he said the usual schedule is fine. I checked the .gov page after and it matched what he said.
Brandon's little brother is graduating in May and has NO idea what he's doing. His counselor told him to just try community college lol
Sounds familiar. Mine basically said the same thing four years ago.
What would you actually tell him

Have somebody walk him through what apprenticeship hours look like, what an actual paycheck looks like year 1 vs year 4, what a license even is. Nobody told me any of that. I had to figure the whole map out after I'd already burned a semester drifting.
You see the email from Dana? Cookout Sat at the shop for the new hires.
Yeah. Not really my thing but I'll show up for 30 min.
Same. At least it's not a union meeting where they make you stay 2 hours lol
Ha. Different world. Just us, Dana, and whoever signs the timecards.
You up. Card's in the mailbox btw
Saw it. Statement's rough. $318 to Gardner Bender and another $147 at the supply house on Lee
Meters again?
Clamp meter, two new pouches, and the torque screwdriver I kept borrowing. Plus the exam app fee comes out next week. It is what it is, I'll make it back on the other side
how the knees holding up. saw you limping at easter setup last yr
boots are worn through on the sole. concrete all day yesterday at the new build off Wendover
gonna ride em another paycheck or two. carhartt pants are about done too but they still close
Mike R told me at the hardware store you're on pace for the sit window in 27. Good.
yeah hours are tracking. slow grind
dont wait til you blow a knee son. get the Red Wings, ill cover half if you need. you been steady, dont be stubborn
Stick with it. Your mom and I knew when you skipped the recruiter tables at the senior fair and went straight to the trade booth you'd find your own lane. This was it.
yeah. fits me better than what they were pitching that day
Honey, your father wants to know if you can swing by Nonna's after work Thursday. The kitchen faucet is dripping again and you know how he is about not bothering a plumber until it's flooding.
yeah i can stop on the way home. tell him not to mess with the shutoff, the one under the sink is old
I'll let him know. She said she'd make you a plate either way. Sunday she wants everyone over here for gravy, your sister too.
tell her i'll be there. tyler might come if the panthers thing is later
Mom is asking if you can help Friday night with the fish trays. Grandma says nobody cuts the bread thick enough except you.
I can come after work. Tell her I remember, two fingers wide or she gives me the look.
She also asked if you are doing the morning thing Sunday or sleeping in again.
Sleeping in this one. I will be there for the table and cleanup.
you good? mom said you've been quiet
yeah just busy. talked to dad saturday, im ok
ok. also did you take the toolbox listing down? i was gonna tell my friend about it
took it down, sold it tuesday. $65
the replies under the bodycam post are insane lol everyone just screaming at each other
did u say anything
nope. read a couple and closed the app
smart. I almost typed something and deleted it twice
Are you still coming by Saturday before Nana's? My kitchen drawer is stuck again.
Yes. I can stop at your place first, then take them to the pharmacy and swing back for Mom's dinner.
Dad said to ask you about the cabinet track, not him. He is saving his lecture for your truck noise.
I already texted him a video of the noise. Waiting for his verdict.
Mom said she can get me on Dr. Halverson's schedule for that weird ear thing if I just call the front desk and drop her name lol
She's been there forever, everyone in that office knows her.
Right? Also Dad fixed my disposal Sunday in like ten minutes. Said the seal was the same kind as something at the plant.
Of course he had the part in his truck.
You leaving in 10? Need to swing by the supply house first
Yeah out the door at 6:20. Same as always
Boyd brought a fresh pack out to the truck. Coming with us on break?
Nah. Gas station coffee run instead. Want one?
Yeah, black, two sugars
Back in 10
Foreman wants two of us to stay till the homeowner walkthrough. Could be 7
Fine. Grab dinner on the way back.
Don't rush that exam book tonight if your hands are already tired from pulling cable.
I skipped the run again so I could do two chapters and check my hours. Feels like everyone else is moving faster.
Fast is not the goal. Correct is the goal. Eat first, then do one chapter clean.
Got it. I was snippy earlier with Tyler too. I'll reset before I open the book.
How many hours you putting in lately? You sound beat.
42 last week, 44 this one. About normal. Foreman's been pushing the Westover finish.
At my old plant the local would've capped that without time and a half. You getting OT?
Straight time past 40. Shop's not set up that way. It is what it is for now.
Are you still going to that open place tomorrow or did Tyler talk you into fishing?
Going in the morning. Fishing after if the weather holds.
Send pictures if there's a spot for your table saw. Also don't forget your half of internet is due Monday.
Already on the calendar. I'll send you the pictures if the back building isn't falling apart.
You want me grabbing the attic totes by myself for the first hour? Forecast says 78 by noon.
Let's split them, but I'm not racing it. Last hot attic stretch ended with that one clinic stop.
Fair. I still have those gummies my cousin left if you need to sleep after.
Nah. I'll do the ibuprofen, shower, pad, and couch. Same boring setup works.
Forecast says 48 at sunrise and calm wind. You still in?
Yeah. After this week, sitting still out there sounds about right.
I'll load my tackle box tonight so we don't wake the neighbors banging around.
I'll make coffee at 4:50 and meet you by the truck.
how'd that nuisance trip job end up. the one where the lady said the AC kicked the breaker every afternoon
found it. condenser was sharing a 20A with the garage freezer, and the contactor on the unit was pitted so it was pulling extra inrush. swapped the contactor, moved the freezer to its own circuit
good. how long did it take you to chase it
two trips. honestly the chasing is the part i actually like. clamp meter on every leg, ruling things out one at a time until the number doesn't lie. better than a day of pulling new romex
You up? Water looks calm enough if we leave by 7.
Yeah. I got stuck watching that level walkthrough last night and still woke up early.
The fishing page I sent had a good photo from Lake Higgins too. Same spot we were talking about.
Saw it. That pushed me over my usual 30 minutes, but I wanted to finish the boss section.
You and Tyler on the Elm Street rough-in tomorrow?
Yeah. Same truck, same start time. We're keeping it simple tonight with the game on.
Good. Don't stay up too late if you're pulling wire in the morning.
We won't. Food, kickoff, done.
Did you order those work gloves or are you waiting?
Ordered the cheaper pair after I did the Sunday numbers. Friday check was $1,402.16.
As long as the truck money and house bills are covered first.
Covered. $225 got moved out, and I still have the small cash tucked away.
Your mother said you worked late. Come after noon then. The pot is covered and your place is not given away.
Thanks, Nonna. I am not making the morning stop today, but I will come wash up before we eat.
Good. Grandpa wants you beside him, not hiding by Tyler talk on your phone.
I will sit with him. Bringing cannoli so do not let Mia steal the first one.
Your mother said your arm was sore. Rest it tonight and eat before work tomorrow.
It's just tender from the clinic stop, not bad. I already handled the $25 there.
you coming sunday? pasta at 1
Good. Listen to the doctor, not all the cousins sending links.
yeah coming straight from the gym
That's the plan. I kept the printout in the truck so I can bring it if he asks next time.
good. you need to eat. you were skin and bones last august
lol nonna i'm eating. three a day now
Water bill jumped 22 bucks again. That rate thing they were voting on last week actually went through?
Yeah. They passed it 6 to 3. I sat through most of it on stream after the Tuesday job.
Of course you did lol
The council seat in our district is up in May. I keep missing the small ones, not missing this one. Going to actually mark it this time.
you gonna be back by 4? game's at 4:30
should be. sunday at the parents' place, mom's doing the usual. dad's been on me about the truck brakes so might run long
ha. tell your mom thanks for the leftovers last time, that bread was unreal
she made nonna's recipe, i'll tell her. nonna's not coming today, her hip's bugging her
you good? you didn't come out and grill last night
yeah talked to my mom for a while. easier than dumping it all on you lol
ha fair. btw your aunt tagged us in some pic from the cookout, you seen it?
yeah notification popped up. didnt open it
My cousin keeps trying to drag me to the precinct meeting next week. Says I gotta pick a side already.
Pass. Told the lady at the DMV the same thing when she asked, kept the box checked unaffiliated. Both sides want me angry about something I can't even see from a ladder.
Ha. Fair.
If one of them ran on lower payroll tax for the small outfits and actually did something about the clinic backlog out by Friendly Ave, I'd probably lean that way. But that's not what they run on.
cashier at Plumbing Supply just asked if either of us qualified for the service discount
what'd you tell her
told her no go for either of us. ran the contractor account, knocked $14 off anyway
works for me
Saw the piece in the News & Record this morning about the chief and the elm st report
Read it?
read it twice. still thinking on it. don't really want to get into it
Fair. Keep your head down on the job site today.
Hammond's office called this morning. Bloodwork all in range
Yeah, he said the same in person last week. Nothing to keep an eye on
Good. Your dad's cousin had to start statins at 33. The man never took care of himself
Lol Im in bed by 10 most nights. Not his life
